description: A/B listening fixture for benchmarks/tts-tone.ts. Six scene-partner lines covering each tagging path: untagged conversational, single-tag (director), multi-sentence with a mid-line shift (director), and a BIG_DELIVERY script parenthetical. `context` is the dialogue just before the line, sent to the director so it judges from the scene as in production. `deliveryTag` is a script parenthetical already mapped to a v3 tag (src/lib/delivery.ts) — those lines skip the director, as in production.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Did you remember to pick up the groceries on your way home?

context.speaker: SAM
context.text: Hey. Sorry I'm late, traffic was a nightmare.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: I kept his letters. Every single one.

context.speaker: RUTH
context.text: You never talk about your brother anymore.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: That's the third time this week you've said that to me.

context.speaker: SAM
context.text: I'll fix the sink tomorrow, I promise.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: I waited by the phone all night. You said you'd call. It doesn't matter now, I suppose.

context.speaker: RUTH
context.text: I know I said I'd call. Something came up.

lines.speaker: MAYA
lines.text: Okay, so here's the thing. I may have told your mother we'd host Thanksgiving. All of it.

context.speaker: SAM
context.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Get out of the car right now, it's going to roll!
